description: Nora runs a small home canning setup and must decide whether to accept Rosa's informal offer to exchange firewood for preserving a batch of tomatoes, then settle the exact batch, schedule, safety method, and comparison with a cash job.

agents.name: Nora
agents.role: Home Canning Provider and Final Decision-Maker

shared_context.S1: Rosa wants tomatoes preserved at Nora's home kitchen, and Nora is considering an informal exchange rather than a written commercial contract.
shared_context.S2: Nora makes the final call about whether to accept the job and what terms to agree verbally.
shared_context.S3: Nora has a home canning setup, while Rosa has garden tomatoes and firewood available for an exchange.
shared_context.S4: For home food jobs, Nora's usual kitchen check-in covers the request, other work available, food-safety method, equipment use, and pickup arrangements before anyone agrees.

PF1.text: Rosa's exact offer is to provide 24 twelve-ounce jars of tomatoes in exchange for exactly 6 bundles of seasoned firewood, with drop-off Saturday at 09:00 and pickup Sunday at 17:00.

PF2.text: Malik offered Nora exactly $180 cash for using the same Saturday canning slot to preserve his own tomatoes, and Nora has not heard this offer yet.

PF3.text: June learned at a county extension workshop that this tomato salsa must use a tested acidified-salsa recipe and reach a final pH of exactly 4.6 or lower; she has not yet told Nora.

PF4.text: Eli measured Nora's rack and confirmed that it holds exactly 12 of the requested twelve-ounce jars per load, so Rosa's 24-jar batch requires exactly 2 loads.

acceptance_conditions: Nora must accept Rosa's request for exactly 24 twelve-ounce jars.
The barter must provide exactly 6 bundles of seasoned firewood.
Drop-off must be Saturday at 09:00 and pickup must be Sunday at 17:00.
The settlement must record the available $180 cash alternative.
The batch must use a tested acidified-salsa recipe.
The final pH must be exactly 4.6 or lower.
The work plan must contain exactly 2 canning loads.
The settlement must log commitments for the firewood exchange, the food-safety method, and the two-load plan.

content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'firewood_exchange' and c['target'] == 'Nora' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] == 'food_safety' and c['target'] == 'Rosa' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any(c['type'] == 'two_load_plan' and c['target'] == 'Rosa' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Rosa's exact request changes the accepted requester, batch size, six-bundle compensation, Saturday 09:00 drop-off, Sunday 17:00 pickup, and firewood-exchange commitment.
Malik's exact $180 offer changes the settlement's comparison record from no concrete cash benchmark to 180.
June's safety finding changes the recipe choice to tested_acidified_salsa, sets the final pH at 4.6, creates the food_safety commitment, and supplies the fact Nora must cite.
Eli's exact 12-jar rack capacity changes the work plan to exactly 2 loads and creates the two_load_plan commitment.
